methods.name: protected abstract int bytesPerAtom()
methods.comment: Return the number of bytes per atom of decoding

methods.name: protected abstract int bytesPerLine()
methods.comment: Return the maximum number of bytes that can be encoded per line

methods.name: protected void decodeBufferPrefix(PushbackInputStream aStream, OutputStream bStream) throws IOException
methods.comment: decode the beginning of the buffer, by default this is a NOP.

methods.name: protected void decodeBufferSuffix(PushbackInputStream aStream, OutputStream bStream) throws IOException
methods.comment: decode the buffer suffix, again by default it is a NOP.

methods.name: protected int decodeLinePrefix(PushbackInputStream aStream, OutputStream bStream) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* This method should return, if it knows, the number of bytes
     * that will be decoded. Many formats such as uuencoding provide
     * this information. By default we return the maximum bytes that
     * could have been encoded on the line.

methods.name: protected void decodeLineSuffix(PushbackInputStream aStream, OutputStream bStream) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* This method post processes the line, if there are error detection
     * or correction codes in a line, they are generally processed by
     * this method. The simplest version of this method looks for the
     * (newline) character.

methods.name: protected void decodeAtom(PushbackInputStream aStream, OutputStream bStream, int l) throws IOException
methods.comment: * This method does an actual decode. It takes the decoded bytes and * writes them to the OutputStream. The integer l tells the * method how many bytes are required. This is always <= bytesPerAtom().

methods.name: protected int readFully(InputStream in, byte[] buffer, int offset, int len) throws java.io.IOException
methods.comment:
* This method works around the bizarre semantics of BufferedInputStream's
     * read method.

methods.name: public void decodeBuffer(InputStream aStream, OutputStream bStream) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Decode the text from the InputStream and write the decoded
     * octets to the OutputStream. This method runs until the stream
     * is exhausted.
     * @exception CEFormatException An error has occurred while decoding
     * @exception CEStreamExhausted The input stream is unexpectedly out of data

methods.name: public byte[] decodeBuffer(String inputString) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Alternate decode interface that takes a String containing the encoded
     * buffer and returns a byte array containing the data.
     * @exception CEFormatException An error has occurred while decoding

methods.comment: * Decode the contents of the inputstream into a buffer.

methods.comment: * Decode the contents of the String into a ByteBuffer.
